references.text: John 5:23–24 elaborates on the same theological principle: that honoring the Son is to honor the Father, and that believing in the words of the Son is to believe in the Father.
John 14:1 repeats the call to believe in God (the Father) in direct connection with faith in Jesus, just as in 12:44.
John 14:9–10 confirms that seeing the Son is to see the Father, and that the Father is in the Son, which is at the heart of the statement that believing in Jesus is believing in the Father.
John 17:20–21 prays that all may believe in Jesus through the words of the apostles, so that they may be one, just as Jesus and the Father are one.
